description.narrative: The project will upgrade the electric power system, increase efficiency, reliability and quality of supply through physical investments in the power infrastructure of the state of Bihar, coupled with a capacity development component. Project investments include installation of new, and renovation and modernization (R&M) of existing transmission substations; installation of new, and reinforcement of existing transmission lines; and improving of distribution systems in seven towns (Bihar Sharif, Motihari, Bettiah, Samastipur, Begusarai, Ara and Buxor) in Bihar.

Output: 3. Non-Physical Investments a. Project implementation support b. Institutional and/or capacity development of BSEB Indicator: Implementation consultant contracts processed, consultants hired and mobilized. Progress/Status: $408,386 has been earmarked under the loan to avail the service of consultants under the position of Senior Transmission and Distribution (T&D) Engineer and T&D Engineer; primarily for supervision of ongoing contracts in Transmission and Distribution components of the loan. BSPHCL recruited a Senior T&D Engineer in May 2013, and initiated the process to recruit another T&D Engineer. BSPHCL found that the performance of the consultant (Senior T&D Engineer) was not up to their expectation. Also BSPHCL took note of the fact that their PMU staffs were adequately competent to supervise the on-going contracts in both Transmission and Distribution components of the loan. Based on these assessments BSPHCL decided to put on hold the recruitment of T&D Engineer and further terminated the on-going contract of the Sr. T&D Engineer- on account of non-performance. BSPHCL intends to utilize the largely unconsumed amount under this category (Construction Supervision) to fund additional packages coming out of loan savings. Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports, loan review missions, consultant reports. Actual value:
